# David Obeys with the Sheep (1 Samuel 17:34)

## Emotional Focus
Being faithful in small things God gives us to do.

## Key KJV
“Thy servant kept his father’s sheep.” (1 Samuel 17:34)

## Gentle Retelling
Young David took care of his father’s sheep every day. He obeyed in the small things, and God prepared him for bigger things.

## Coloring Prompt
Young David gently watching over sheep on green hills with his sling nearby.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Obeying in little things makes our hearts ready for God.”
